The official modpack Yuusha!

Warning : This modpack uses high perfomance  

_1.20.1 , fabric for java_

This includes : 

                           +A lot of Create mods----------------> for factories and farming

                           +Metro Transit Railway (MTR)--------> for public transport (trains, boats, metro, airplanes)

                           +Better end undefinedand nether

                           +Yuushya townscape and modeling-> for the urban landscape and special modeling

                           +as of1.02 we added a car mod-------> for driving

+as of 1.03 you can now play multiplayer on our modpack without any servers!

                           +More coming soon!
